research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: TYBR Health is focused on developing a sprayable hydrogel to prevent scar formation on internal organs post-surgery. Their research includes systems and methods for delivering multi-component fluids, which involve a device with a tube, mixer, and nozzle. This device is designed to carry and mix components of a fluid separately before application, ensuring precise delivery and effectiveness of the hydrogel. This innovation aims to enhance surgical outcomes by minimizing scar tissue formation.

press_references.value: TYBR Health Announces FDA 510(k) Clearance for B3 GEL™ System, a Flowable Bio-Gel to Protect Healing Tissue and Preserve Function

product_launches.description: TYBR Health received FDA 510(k) clearance for its B3 GEL System, a bioresorbable, flowable gel barrier designed to protect healing tissue and preserve function after surgery. The company plans to commercially launch the product by the end of 2025.

overview_description.description:
TYBR is a medical device company developing a sprayable hydrogel to keep internal organs scar-free after surgery.

Internal scarring is the #1 complication of surgery, and TYBR's naturally derived solution reduces scarring by 75% preclinically.

It was founded by Tim Keane and Alex Smith in Houston, Texas in 2020,
